output.noDocuments: No document is open. Open one in the Document Editor first (up to 3).
output.obsPathHint: The OBS path is set in Settings.
output.step1: In OBS, add a Source: Window Capture → choose "MotionForge Lite Output".
output.step2: If you use Green Screen: on that Source add a Filter → Chroma Key.
output.step3: If you use 9:16: OBS Settings → Video → set the Canvas to 720×1280.
output.step4: In OBS, click Start Virtual Camera.
